concepts.evidence_backed_title: Who Owns an AI Agent’s Access? A Decision-Rights Map for the C-Suite
concepts.question_answered: Which decisions belong to security, technology, finance, legal, business, and the board—and which remain empirically unresolved?
source_base: OFF public CISO and Executive AI Leverage reports as disclosed overlap only
concepts.book_connections: Workload identity, zero trust, capability security, delegation, and organizational decision-rights literature; no book is verified in the current production index.
concepts.recommended_format: 10-minute Murray executive briefing with a responsibility matrix and one worked deployment scenario
concepts.original_contribution: Separates decision rights from job-title stereotypes and shows how a matched case can distinguish disagreement from responsibility.
concepts.what_not_to_claim: Do not claim that any role usually owns the decision, that OFF respondents represent all executives, or that a matrix proves control effectiveness.
concepts.intended_source_record: OFF_video with full transcript, timestamps, sources, OFF ownership, advisory and sponsorship disclosures, and named-human review
concepts.youtube_role: Discoverable executive answer and invitation to contribute a rights-cleared matched case.
concepts.off_companion_page_role: Host the matrix, definitions, evidence lineage, counterpoints, methods, consent route, corrections, and sources.

sponsorship.conflict_risk: A vendor may frame its buyer as the owner.
sponsorship.required_disclosure: Funding, product, advisory, and investment relationships.
sponsorship.publication_independence: OFF retains script, sources, and corrections.

concepts.evidence_backed_title: One Agent, One Session, or One Task? The Identity-Granularity Decision
concepts.question_answered: What are the tradeoffs among per-agent, per-instance, per-session, per-task, and privacy-preserving identities?
concepts.book_connections: Non-human identity, workload identity, capability systems, and privacy engineering; verify editions before citation.
concepts.recommended_format: 12-minute design comparison using four diagrams and a context checklist
concepts.original_contribution: Turns a repeated recommendation into a scoped design decision with failure and privacy tradeoffs.
concepts.what_not_to_claim: Do not say every agent needs a globally unique or publicly linkable identity or that one pattern is universally best.
concepts.intended_source_record: OFF_video plus rights-cleared diagram assets and timestamped methodological statements
concepts.youtube_role: Answer the architecture question with an accessible comparison.
concepts.off_companion_page_role: Provide pattern table, definitions, limitations, source locators, and implementation-study invitation.

sponsorship.conflict_risk: Protocol sponsor may position its identifier as the solution.

concepts.evidence_backed_title: Least Privilege Is Not Enough: Authority Across Multi-Agent Delegation
concepts.question_answered: How should authority attenuate when an agent delegates to tools, agents, or spawned subagents?
concepts.book_connections: Capability security, delegation, distributed systems, and zero-trust authorization; production book records are absent.
concepts.recommended_format: 10-minute chain-of-authority walkthrough with one safe failure scenario
concepts.original_contribution: Shows where principal linkage, attenuation, discovery, and shutdown must travel across the delegation graph.
concepts.what_not_to_claim: Do not claim that staging recommendations are proven controls or that multi-agent vulnerabilities are prevalent in production.
concepts.intended_source_record: OFF_video with technical scope, version, safe diagrams, and no exploitable configuration
concepts.youtube_role: Explain a concrete governance problem beyond generic least-privilege advice.
concepts.off_companion_page_role: Publish the authority-chain worksheet, research gaps, sources, and correction route.

sponsorship.conflict_risk: Vendor may promote proprietary delegation controls.
sponsorship.funding_findings_separation: No product ranking or prescribed protocol.

concepts.evidence_backed_title: Human Approval or Consent Fatigue? Choosing Oversight by Consequence
concepts.question_answered: When should humans approve actions, when should systems monitor them, and when should hard limits block them?
concepts.book_connections: Human factors, automation bias, safety engineering, and usable security; no verified book analysis currently supports a conclusion.
concepts.recommended_format: 12-minute scenario lab with three action-risk tiers and four control options
concepts.original_contribution: Explains why complementary controls are not necessarily opposing positions and identifies the measurements needed for a real debate.
concepts.what_not_to_claim: Do not claim human approval makes agents safe, automated monitors work at machine speed, or low friction proves effective oversight.
concepts.intended_source_record: OFF_video with scenario instrument, no private participant data, and explicit research-status labels
concepts.youtube_role: Provide a practical decision framework and recruit workflow-study participants.
concepts.off_companion_page_role: Host scenario cards, survey protocol, measures, limitations, and future results.

sponsorship.conflict_risk: Monitoring vendor may define more alerts as better oversight.

concepts.evidence_backed_title: Why an Agent-Security Benchmark Is Not a Production Incident Rate
concepts.question_answered: What can synthetic benchmarks establish, and what additional evidence is needed before deployment or prevalence claims?
concepts.book_connections: Measurement theory, external validity, security evaluation, and model risk; verify any selected texts before use.
concepts.recommended_format: Eight-minute evidence ladder from synthetic task to production decision
concepts.original_contribution: Separates capability, tradeoff, prevalence, prediction, and control-effectiveness claims.
concepts.what_not_to_claim: Do not infer production prevalence, universal model safety, or control effectiveness from benchmark rank.
concepts.intended_source_record: OFF_video with versioned benchmark locators and explicit independent-verification needs
concepts.youtube_role: Correct a common evidence-category mistake in executive language.
concepts.off_companion_page_role: Host the evidence ladder, version table, linked studies, and validity-study protocol.

sponsorship.conflict_risk: Model or benchmark sponsor may seek favorable comparison.
sponsorship.required_disclosure: Model, benchmark, author, and funding relationships.
sponsorship.funding_findings_separation: No ranking or sponsor-defined evidence ladder.

concepts.evidence_backed_title: Killing the Agent: Revocation, Shutdown, and What Gets Left Behind
concepts.question_answered: How should organizations retire credentials, integrations, data, delegated authority, and subagents after shutdown or cancellation?
concepts.book_connections: Identity lifecycle, incident response, resilience, and decommissioning; current index contains no verified book evidence.
concepts.recommended_format: 10-minute postmortem checklist with a fictionalized safe example
concepts.original_contribution: Extends governance beyond launch to canceled and abandoned deployments and makes completeness testable.
concepts.what_not_to_claim: Do not claim short-lived credentials solve lifecycle risk or that canceled projects commonly leave access behind without measured evidence.
concepts.intended_source_record: OFF_video with checklist, timestamps, and clearly labeled hypothetical example
concepts.youtube_role: Answer a neglected operational question and recruit negative cases.
concepts.off_companion_page_role: Host retirement checklist, evidence fields, safe submission process, and limitations.

sponsorship.conflict_risk: Vendor may present its lifecycle feature as complete.
sponsorship.data_access_limits: No submitted case or participant data.

concepts.evidence_backed_title: The CFO’s Agent-Governance Question: What Evidence Earns a Budget Line?
concepts.question_answered: Which cost, loss, value, control, and time-horizon evidence should finance require before funding agent governance?
source_base: OFF public CISO and CFO reports as disclosed overlap only
concepts.book_connections: Control economics, technology investment, cyber-risk quantification, and insurance; verify editions and applicability.
concepts.recommended_format: 10-minute decision memo with three funding paths and explicit unknowns
concepts.original_contribution: Moves from a directional budget-gap observation to the evidence finance needs to make and revisit a decision.
concepts.what_not_to_claim: Do not say CFOs believe a dedicated line is required, that OFF’s selective sample represents enterprises, or that spend proves safety.
concepts.intended_source_record: OFF_video with OFF-ownership disclosure, exact figures and bases where cited, and independent context
concepts.youtube_role: Give finance and security a shared evidence vocabulary.
concepts.off_companion_page_role: Host the memo template, study invitation, disclosures, sources, and corrections.

sponsorship.conflict_risk: Insurer, advisor, or vendor may benefit from a dedicated budget category.
sponsorship.required_disclosure: Commercial, advisory, investment, and OFF relationships.
sponsorship.publication_independence: No-spend and delay cases remain valid.

concepts.evidence_backed_title: What Should the Board Ask About AI Agents? Seven Assurance Questions
concepts.question_answered: Which bounded questions can a board ask about inventory, authority, evidence, incidents, ownership, materiality, and shutdown?
source_base: OFF public-board community page as format overlap only

concepts.what_not_to_claim: Do not prescribe one board standard, imply directors agreed, or present a checklist as assurance or legal advice.
concepts.intended_source_record: OFF_video with board-governance scope, no private dinner material, transcript rights, and corrections
concepts.youtube_role: Provide a concise public board briefing and recruit attributable board evidence.
concepts.off_companion_page_role: Host evidence examples, jurisdiction notes, limitations, sources, and consented research invitation.
